attribution: Tamminen A, Turunen R, Barth D, Vidgren V, Wiebe MG; VTT; dataset (2022), Zenodo 5846028
reverse_direction_role: Descriptive retrospective sensitivity only; not a second prospective experiment
feature_scaling: Training-only column mean and population SD; zero training SD replaced by 1
query_join: Within exact source sheet, strict online_time <= offline_time; no future interpolation; retain all raw sample IDs and target missingness

history_features.mean: Arithmetic mean of finite observed records with query-window <= online_time <= query
history_features.integral: Trapezoids through only observed causal prefix, no extrapolation before first or after last observation

recipe_features: Elapsed time, time squared, explicit strain indicator, documented planned pH/YE/glucose class; no actual feed assay values
excluded_inputs: Offline CDW, mucic acid, glucose and galacturonate assays
Evaporation/sample-corrected offline volume and final volume
Acid pump rate/volume, base pump rate/volume, system calculated volume
RQ, vessel position, replicate number and batch ID
Actual feed composition assays with unknown availability time
Other vessels, past offline labels and future online records
scoring: Clip predictions at zero; retain every feature-eligible measured target; primary metric is equal-weight mean of ten held-out culture RMSEs; also report pooled RMSE and MAE
model_selection: No hyperparameter search, inner validation or choosing winners from test-round outcomes; four fixed descriptive strategies
scope_limits: Dataset/schema and causal feature design selected after article reading and raw-field inspection, before any new model scoring. This is not a prospective blinded trial.

Twenty real cultures belong to two shared experimental rounds and ten matched condition pairs. Vessels and shared feed bottles within a round are correlated; ten cultures are not ten independent experimental rounds.

Round 1 to 2 is the prespecified primary direction; round 2 to 1 is only retrospective sensitivity. Both rounds share laboratory, apparatus, strains and recipe design; no new species/site/scale generalization.

Online observation timestamps are treated as signal availability times. Raw signal arrival, preprocessing delays and assay-return logs are absent; this is conditional retrospective causal replay, not verified online deployment.
No label interpolation. Offline initial samples without preceding online records are retained with an explicit exclusion; remaining observed samples need an online record no older than 0.5 h.

CDW is the primary measured biomass target. Mucic acid values were corrected by authors for sample removal and evaporation using end-of-run volumes; secondary scores predict that retrospective corrected proxy, not instantaneous broth product concentration.

Documented faulty acid pump records and dependent system volume are excluded. CER/OUR remain author-calculated native signals without independently audited sensor calibration, native units or processing formula; their integrals are not intracellular metabolic flux.
Actual feed substrate concentrations differ between rounds, but assay timing is unknown, so those values appear only in provenance inventory, not model inputs.
No post-test tuning, confidence-interval significance claim or full-paper original ML reproduction. Original article is a cultivation study without this soft-sensor algorithm.
No omics integration, adaptive laboratory evolution, enzyme engineering, wet-lab strain optimization, closed-loop control, energy reduction or publication superiority demonstrated.
